_doc: まちがいさがし 'part' differences: per theme/sprite, the box(es) to repaint as [x0, y0, x1, y1] fractions of the sprite image, and what that part should become. Used by generate-spot-part-variants.py. keepShape: true for a change inside the outline (eyes, a pattern) — the silhouette is kept exactly. rejected: true marks one whose output was reviewed by eye and judged unusable (too subtle, or visibly broken) after 2 seeds — skipped by the generator.
